project.name: UK CAER TCS Digital Twin PM Package
project.description: A digital-twin PM operating product for the Lexington UK CAER Outreach & Education Center (DeVere Construction). Contains 51 Python builders generating XLSX workbooks and HTML dashboards across 10 construction domains, plus 225 Markdown specs covering TCS governance, agent boot protocols, and onboarding materials.

nodes.name: Gate Readiness Builders
nodes.summary: Generates the 9-gate readiness HTML board (A0-D2 lifecycle) and A1/A2 evidence closure/receipt validation builders. Reads TPM, A1A2 Sage, Command Center, Events, Validation Queue, QA Audit workbooks. Outputs HTML board + README.

nodes.name: Sage Verification Builder
nodes.summary: Generates XLSX verifying Sage CM job metadata, cost codes, SOV, and vendor setup status against TCS A1/A2 gate requirements.

nodes.name: PM Command Center Builder
nodes.summary: Central aggregation builder. Reads WBS, TPM, submittals, schedule, BOQ, safety, RFI, high-risk, weekly snapshot, skill drafts, A1/A2 sage, day1 rollout, exec overview, owner review, QA audit, first review, approval ledger, data spine, event calendar, decision ledger, evidence token, validation workbooks. Outputs master PM Command Center XLSX + README.

nodes.name: PM Package & TPM Builder
nodes.summary: Master builder creating TPM_AND_GATE_CONTROLS.xlsx with CSI division tracking, 9-gate controls, procurement rows, cost code mapping, and TCS citations. Foundation workbook consumed by most other builders.

nodes.name: Procurement Builders
nodes.summary: Generates B1/B2 procurement activation HTML board and cost/SOV commitment readiness board. Sequences buyout, submittal release, TPM setup, Rooter prerequisites.

nodes.name: Field Operations Builders
nodes.summary: Generates field Work Instruction (WI) and Inspection/Test Plan (ITP) checklist packages, action plan packages, high-risk trade/preinstall meeting packets. Links to Rooter/Setup/Execution/Hold Point/Tooter phases.

nodes.name: Evidence & Compliance Builders
nodes.summary: Generates evidence token standard, P0 evidence intake board, validation architecture/QC plan, validation queue/zone assignments, and package QA audit workbooks.

nodes.name: Cost Control Builders
nodes.summary: Generates BOQ/BOM cost code mapping (WBS bridge, BOM rows, estimate quantities, Sage review, inference rows), schedule logic chain, submittal schedule, and RFI register.

nodes.name: Document Control Builders
nodes.summary: Generates control document revision board (HTML), Sage/OneDrive governance board, TCS control pack, and package index/manifest.

nodes.name: Reporting & Review Builders
nodes.summary: Generates daily PM operating board, weekly snapshot, executive overview, owner progress review, first PM product review, PM product review conductor board, PM productization board, and TPM release readiness board.

nodes.name: HR & Training Builders
nodes.summary: Generates human PM onboarding board (HTML), PM training package (runbook + tracker XLSX), day1 role rollout package, and safety/quality plans.

nodes.name: Risk Management Builders
nodes.summary: Generates live action approval ledger, PM decision/action ledger, and deliverables completion roadmap.

nodes.name: Data Spine & Navigator Builders
nodes.summary: Generates PM data spine/asset graph, PM asset navigator (HTML), PM event calendar, validation zone board, and PM harness continuity.

nodes.name: Skill Draft Builders
nodes.summary: Generates Cowork skill draft packages: tcs-sage-governance-check, tcs-package-qa-audit, tcs-source-query-receipt. Also draft skill forward test packet and reusable skill flow package.

nodes.name: WBS & TCS Foundation Builder
nodes.summary: Generates verified WBS/DFOW workbook - the foundational work breakdown structure that all other builders reference.

nodes.name: Master Control Builder (JS)

tours.name: Build Pipeline Tour
tours.description: Follow the data flow from source extracts through Python builders to generated XLSX workbooks and HTML dashboards

stops.title: 1. Source Data
stops.narration: The pipeline starts with extracted text from UK CAER bid specs, drawings, and addenda, plus NotebookLM metadata JSONs that configure notebook sources.

stops.title: 2. Foundation Builders
stops.narration: The WBS builder creates the verified Work Breakdown Structure/DFOW. The PM Package builder creates the master TPM_AND_GATE_CONTROLS.xlsx with CSI division tracking, 9-gate controls, and TCS citations. These are consumed by all downstream builders.

stops.title: 3. Domain Builders
stops.narration: 51 Python builders use openpyxl to read foundation workbooks and generate domain-specific outputs. Each builder declares BOUNDARY text, SOURCE_CHAIN citations, and OUT_XLSX/OUT_HTML/OUT_MD output paths. They write to both OneDrive (TCS_DIR) and local (tcs_outputs/).

stops.title: 4. Generated XLSX Workbooks
stops.narration: 36 Excel workbooks are generated: master control/command center aggregations, foundation WBS/schedule/action plan data, procurement/cost tracking, field/risk registers, evidence/validation structures, and reporting snapshots.

stops.title: 5. Generated HTML Dashboards
stops.narration: 14 HTML dashboards are generated with responsive CSS, metrics panels, and interactive sections. Gate readiness, daily operations, procurement activation, evidence intake, validation zones, and owner-facing boards.

stops.title: 6. Owner-Facing Outputs
stops.narration: The pipeline culminates in owner-facing boards and executive overviews that DeVere ownership uses to track project compliance and TCS lifecycle progress.

stops.title: 7. Documentation
stops.narration: Each generated deliverable gets a README.md documenting purpose, source chain, boundary statement, sheet descriptions, and usage instructions.

tours.name: Construction Domain Tour
tours.description: Walk through all 10 business domains of the TCS Digital Twin PM Package

stops.title: 1. Gate Readiness
stops.narration: The canonical TCS 9-gate lifecycle (A0 Pre-Bid through D2 Warranty) governs all project advancement. The Gate Readiness Board shows evidence gaps, TPM/procurement dependencies, and validation posture for each gate. No gate passes without documented evidence.

stops.title: 2. PM Command Center
stops.narration: The central aggregation hub linking all domains. The PM Command Center XLSX and daily operating board HTML provide the PM with a single surface for project status, next actions, and blockers.

stops.title: 3. Procurement
stops.narration: B1/B2 Procurement Activation Board sequences buyout, submittal release, TPM setup, and Rooter prerequisites. Cost/SOV Commitment Readiness Board tracks financial controls. Sage verification ensures CM metadata alignment.

stops.title: 4. Field Operations
stops.narration: Field WI/ITP checklist packages, action plan packages (Rooter/Setup/Execution/Hold Point/Tooter phases), high-risk trade packets, and preinstall meeting packets. Each action plan maps to exactly one DFOW.

stops.title: 5. Evidence & Compliance
stops.narration: Evidence token standard, P0 evidence intake board, validation architecture/QC plan, validation queue/zone assignments, and package QA audit. Every material fact must be cited, inferred, validated, or marked with its evidence state.

stops.title: 6. Cost Control
stops.narration: BOQ/BOM cost code mapping bridges WBS to estimate quantities. Schedule logic chain provides sequencing. Submittal schedule and RFI register track document flow. No buyout before A2, no pay without evidence.

stops.title: 7. Risk Management
stops.narration: Live action approval ledger controls what can happen. PM decision/action ledger tracks choices. Deliverables completion roadmap shows what remains. High-risk trade and preinstall packets flag critical work sequences.

stops.title: 8. Document Control
stops.narration: Control document revision board tracks all document versions. Sage/OneDrive governance board manages file system authority. TCS control pack and package index/manifest provide the complete deliverable inventory.

stops.title: 9. HR & Training
stops.narration: Human PM onboarding board, 8-week training syllabus, day1 role rollout packages, safety/quality plans. Project-specific packs for Chokshi, Franklin, Owen County, and Richmond with foreman cheat sheets.

stops.title: 10. Reporting
stops.narration: Daily PM operating board, weekly snapshots, executive overview, owner progress review, PM product review conductor, productization board, and TPM release readiness board. Cascading from daily ops to executive visibility.
